name: Maximum Parents of Learning Spaces
statement: Every finite learning space is maximum-generated. On $n\ge1$ coordinates, if it has $q$ inclusion-minimal missing consistent patterns, it has a coordinate-hyperplane convex realization in $\mathbb R^n$ and a rank-$n$ maximum parent with at most $q+2n$ auxiliary coordinates. The zero-coordinate learning space needs none.
proof: Union closure makes every minimal missing pattern have exactly one positive literal, say $a=1$ with prerequisites $A$ fixed to zero. Accessibility orders every feasible state by feasible prefixes. Give earlier learned elements geometrically larger positive coordinates, absent elements value $-1$, and use the inequalities $x_a<(n+1)^{-1}\sum_{b\in A}x_b$. Every feasible state satisfies them strictly and every forbidden orthant violates one. Adding a bounding box and applying the strict-realization construction gives the stated parent bound.
